newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia takes measures to boost foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia takes measures to boost foreign investment.

text.p: The Tunisian government on Wednesday decided on several measures aimed at boosting foreign investment, officials said.
They said a cabinet meeting, chaired by President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali, has decided to look at how more incentives might be offered to foreign investors depending on the economic sector.
The cabinet decided to reduce paperwork for foreign investors in procedures for their first establishement and after.
The cabinet also decided to intensify contacts with foreign firms having a potential for investments. The banking sector was to be associated in these contacts, the officials said.
